name: ht5023
title: HT5023
description: Holtek HT5023 (ARM Cortex-M0, 256 KiB flash, 32 KiB SRAM). Builds Arduino-framework projects against the HT5023 SDK's own core, so libraries from the PlatformIO registry can be used on the part. Uploads over SWD with a SEGGER J-Link, or over USB-UART through the resident bootloader.
